description: iMessage GROUP chats on the brand's own Sendblue line (or LoopMessage sender). action list (default): the groups Hermoso started or saw a message in (neither provider lists a line's groups). Sendblue (beta, its Blue Ocean plan to start one): start { contacts [2-24 phone numbers or Apple Account emails], text (the first message), name?, from (the line) } needs confirm:true; send { groupId, text, media? } into a group; get { groupId } (name, photo, members); add / remove { groupId, contact } (removal needs at least four members); rename { groupId, name ('' clears) }; photo { groupId, photoUrl (https / Library id; '' removes) }. LoopMessage: send { groupId } only, into a group the brand is already in (its API cannot start, rename or change a group). A person who opted out of the brand's iMessages is not added. The provider's own terms apply (no unsolicited messaging). Free in Hermoso; the provider bills its plan. Needs the brand's own Sendblue or LoopMessage account connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
